configuration.operator_notes: The upstream Mihon-format extension index, filtered to Arabic. Read in the same nested extensionList shape a reader consumes, so the repository can be populated from the ecosystem's real source instead of one hand-listed GitHub repository. Their signing key is pinned here, and because the publisher takes the majority signer as the repository anchor, a repository dominated by these extensions advertises the key a reader needs in order to accept them.
Third-party Arabic source. Its own certificate is pinned and is scoped only to its own package, so it cannot sign for anything else.

Shura's own Arabic source, built from this project's generator and signed with the Shura publisher key. The signing key here is the operator's, held out of Git and injected at build time; it is the same digest the app pins, which is what lets this artifact run at all. artifact_path points at the committed signed copy rather than the Gradle release output: build/ is gitignored and is wiped by clean, so a path into it silently yields no candidates on any machine that has not just run a release build.
